chapter: The Eruption (volcano) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (#841): a lead line the ear can follow, the heat carried by heavy guitar and big drums, not by noise, sub bass or high clatter
purpose: Master of Game/Music/magma-electro.ogg: written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository (C:/Users/panrd/AI/output/masters-841 on the desktop, with its .raw.wav); this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan -- batch-night-magma.ps1 -> generate-music.ps1 -Loop -NoCotCaption
format: 48000 Hz, 32-bit float PCM, stereo -- 48 kHz is the model's fixed native rate

request.caption: Dark electro rock instrumental: a gritty driving distorted guitar riff, a warm catchy analog synth lead melody carrying the tune in the mid range, the distorted electric guitar doubling the hook in the chorus, punchy tight rock drums with a dark snare, a bass guitar following the riff, a build-up into a big peak with warm wide synth chords, hot and aggressive, warm modern production, wide stereo mix with synths and guitars panned left and right, stereo delays, no vocals
request.lm_negative_prompt: vocals, singing, choir, audience applause, crowd noise, live recording, boomy sub bass, growling bass, distorted 808, sharp lead stabs, risers, glitch, siren synths, industrial noise textures, white noise sweeps, harsh sizzling hi-hats, long drum-only sections, drum solo, bright crash cymbals, splashy cymbals, cymbal wash, open hi-hats, tambourine, shakers, synth bass, bright supersaw, fizzy synths, sizzling high synth leads, airy shimmer
